finding_summary.update: AgentOpt is a real reversible generate-and-test self-improvement loop with a materially stronger-than-greedy lexicographic gate, but its quality certificate is fixed-time rather than anytime-valid, its Wilson regression intervals are adaptively re-inspected during resampling, its auto holdout can rotate into train and is therefore not a terminal untouched outer surface, and evidence persistence is best-effort rather than the sole crash-replay authority.
finding_summary.remaining_composition: real reversible self-improvement + candidate-local anytime-valid CERTIFY + durable candidate-crossing statistical spending + provider/evaluator write-ahead reconciliation + terminal cache-only OUTER

connector_discovery_mutation_incident.action: A mutating create-branch capability was mistakenly invoked while probing connector capabilities.
connector_discovery_mutation_incident.violation: Connector discovery/capability probing must be read-only; temporary/noop branch creation is forbidden.
connector_discovery_mutation_incident.cleanup_blocker: After the incident, read-only connector discovery exposed no branch-delete/delete-ref action; no additional mutation was attempted.
connector_discovery_mutation_incident.next_invocation_requirement: Control revision 13 requires an equivalent explicit self_improvement role-local read-only connector-discovery/write-boundary guard before the next substantive invocation. The current self_improvement config revision 6 lacks that explicit local guard. Until repository control is updated, a subsequent invocation must do no substantive semantic work and should record a role-local blocker/no-op receipt.

termination.blocker: role-local explicit read-only connector-discovery/write-boundary guard required after recorded mutation incident
termination.exact_next_action: After an explicit self_improvement role-local read-only connector-discovery/write-boundary guard is present, search public self-improvement implementations for an end-to-end composition of AgentOpt-like real reversible improvement, PACE/Harn-like anytime-valid candidate certification, durable candidate-crossing statistical spending, and Auto-Quant-V2-like terminal cache-only outer evaluation. Prioritize code/tests with immutable comparison IDs, write-ahead evaluator/provider reconciliation, crash injection, and a structurally non-iterative outer namespace.
